response.overview: ECHOES OF WHEELS follows Ashokan, a cyclist whose life has been deeply connected with the road and the simple rhythm of travelling on two wheels. Through his journey, the film explores his relationship with cycling, the memories carried along the roads he has travelled, and the meaning that this journey holds in his life. It is a portrait of a man whose story continues to move forward, one pedal at a time.
response.tagline: Some journeys are measured in miles. Others in memories
response.title: ECHOES OF WHEELS
